what: first view prints: 12 prints from a 37-anchor stick guide, capsule shapes, riso painting, dot screen in print space (cell 14 print px)

changed: rear-route turn-back prints (RT3/RT2/RT1, head held on the door); L_in head yaw increased

what: first frames: MLS forward mesh + bilinear forward splat
saw: rigid skull reported anisotropy 50: rigid MLS cannot absorb the print's 2x scale
changed: MLS runs in film units (handles and grid halved first)

what: turn frames (3.5-3.8 s) with handles lerped in 2D between view prints
saw: torso and neck folded (aniso up to 1800, 60+ folded cells): hidden left/right handle pairs coincide in the profile print and separate in the turn, tearing the print between two coincident points; the neck's handles are collinear in the rear view (affine singular)
changed: handles follow the stick guide continuously (monotone cubic in yaw/pitch/posture) instead of a 2D lerp; handles closer than 30 print px are merged; an affine layer whose handles are near-collinear falls back to similarity; torso handles reduced to the centre line

saw: coat anisotropy 23: the throat handle (in the torso set) followed the lowered neck and dragged the chest
changed: throat removed from the coat's handles (it belongs to the neck)

saw: the sitting person's hand ran into the lying dog's head and the person was cut by the frame edge
changed: back to 215 px/m with the sill at x=330; the person steps back in depth (scale 0.8) to a bench at the far left

what: head carriage as 2D rotations scaled by profile-ness
saw: in the rear views the head popped up (giraffe) because the lowered head was faded out with the profile factor
changed: neck and head pitch moved onto the guide (so a lowered head is lowered in every view); lie/stand head formulas blended by the lie curve (no pop at the switch)

what: look-back at 7.46 over the far shoulder
saw: mid-swing (7.50) the head passed edge-on and the motion stretch drew the ears into streaks
changed: motion-stretch offset capped at 7 px; eye drawn whenever the eye side faces the viewer at all (threshold -0.2)
